question: Which of the following cups/trophies is NOT related to the Indian domestic cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Durand Cup**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Durand Cup is a football competition in India.
 
• It is one of the oldest football tournaments in the world, having been founded in 1888.
 
• The competition is named after Sir Mortimer Durand, the then Foreign Secretary in charge of India.
 
• The Durand Cup is not associated with cricket and is instead a significant event in Indian football.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Duleep Trophy**

 
 
• The Duleep Trophy is a first-class cricket tournament in India.
 
• It was named after Kumar Shri Duleepsinhji of Nawanagar, an Indian cricket player.
 
• The competition started in 1961-62 and is played between teams representing geographical zones of India.
 
• The Duleep Trophy is an important event in the Indian domestic cricket calendar.
 
 
 
• **Deodhar Trophy**
 
 
• The Deodhar Trophy is a List A cricket competition in Indian domestic cricket.
 
• It was named after Prof. D. B. Deodhar, who is known as the Grand Old Man of Indian cricket.
 
• The tournament started in 1973-74 and is played between teams selected by the national selectors from the best of the domestic players.
 
• The Deodhar Trophy is a significant tournament for aspiring cricketers in India.
 
 
 
• **Ranji Trophy**
 
 
• The Ranji Trophy is a first-class cricket championship played in India.
 
• The competition is named after the famous Indian cricketer Ranjitsinhji.
 
• It was founded in 1934 and is played between various regional teams across India.
 
• The Ranji Trophy is considered the premier first-class cricket tournament in India.
